name: contract_approval_and_signing
description: Defines contract signing authority, value-based approval requirements, vendor documentation requirements, and approved digital signature software requirements.

variables.name: contract_value
variables.description: Total monetary value of the contract in US dollars.

variables.name: signer_position
variables.description: The organizational position of the person signing the contract.

variables.name: has_written_legal_delegation
variables.description: Whether Legal has provided written delegation authorizing a manager or employee to sign this contract.

variables.name: has_legal_manager_approval
variables.description: Whether the Legal Manager approved the contract. Required for contracts valued at $50,000 or less.

variables.name: has_head_of_legal_approval
variables.description: Whether the Head of Legal approved the contract. Required for contracts valued above $50,000.

variables.name: has_cfo_approval
variables.description: Whether the CFO approved the contract. Also required for contracts valued above $250,000.

variables.name: vendor_provided_tin
variables.description: Whether the vendor provided its Tax Identification Number (TIN).

variables.name: vendor_provided_certificate_of_incorporation
variables.description: Whether the vendor provided its Certificate of Incorporation.

variables.name: is_digital_signing
variables.description: Whether the contract will be signed using digital signature software.

variables.name: is_company_approved_signature_software
variables.description: Whether the digital signature software used is approved by the company.

rules.description: Contracts with a nonnegative stated value may proceed subject to the policy's approval, signing, vendor documentation, and signature software requirements.
A contract is invalid if it is signed by someone who is not a C-level executive or director and has no written delegation from Legal.
rules.condition: signer_position != "c_level_executive" AND signer_position != "director" AND has_written_legal_delegation != true

rules.description: Contracts valued at $50,000 or less are invalid without Legal Manager approval.
Contracts valued above $50,000 and at or below $250,000 are invalid without Head of Legal approval.
rules.condition: contract_value > 50000 AND contract_value <= 250000 AND has_head_of_legal_approval != true

rules.description: Contracts valued above $250,000 are invalid without Head of Legal approval.
Contracts valued above $250,000 are invalid without CFO approval.
A contract is invalid if the vendor has not provided its Tax Identification Number.
A contract is invalid if the vendor has not provided its Certificate of Incorporation.
Digital signing is invalid if the signature software is not company-approved.

examples.question: Can a $40,000 contract be signed by a director after Legal Manager approval if the vendor supplied both required documents?
examples.explanation: The signer is an authorized signatory, the Legal Manager approved the contract within the applicable value band, and both required vendor documents were provided.

examples.question: Can a $300,000 contract proceed with Head of Legal approval but no CFO approval?
examples.explanation: Contracts valued above $250,000 require approval from both the Head of Legal and the CFO.

examples.question: Can a manager sign a $20,000 contract without written delegation from Legal?
examples.explanation: Managers cannot sign contracts without written delegation from Legal.

examples.question: Can a $75,000 contract be digitally signed using unapproved software?
examples.explanation: Digital signing must use company-approved signature software.
